// Tests of the migration tools for records, run with node --test.
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { test } from 'node:test'

import { bodyOf, chunksOf, translationProblems } from './translation.mjs'

// Vietnamese words and a dash, written as escapes so that this file stays ASCII.
const TITLE_VI = 'Ti\u00eau \u0111\u1ec1'
const CELL_VI = 'b\u1ec7'
const BEFORE_VI = 'Tr\u01b0\u1edbc'
const EM_DASH = '\u2014'
const HEADER = '---\ntitle: T\nsummary: S.\ncomponent: all\ntype: record\nstatus: record\nids: []\n---\n'
const BANNER = '<!-- record banner: generated -->\n> Record.\n<!-- end of record banner -->\n'

const ORIGINAL = [`# ${TITLE_VI}`, '', 'plain line', `| a | ${CELL_VI} |`, '```', 'code', '```', `${BEFORE_VI} ${EM_DASH} after`, ''].join('\n')
const GOOD = ['# Title', '', 'plain line', '| a | bee |', '```', 'code', '```', 'Before, after', ''].join('\n')

test('bodyOf drops the header, the record banner and the blank lines around them', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(bodyOf(`${HEADER}\n${BANNER}\n${GOOD}`), GOOD.split('\n'))
  assert.deepEqual(bodyOf(`${HEADER}\n${GOOD}`), GOOD.split('\n'))
  assert.deepEqual(bodyOf(`\n${GOOD}`), GOOD.split('\n'))
})

test('a translation that keeps its original line for line has no problem', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(translationProblems(ORIGINAL, `${HEADER}\n${BANNER}\n${GOOD}`), [])
})

test('each way a translation breaks its original is named with its line', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(translationProblems(ORIGINAL, `${GOOD}extra\n`), ['the translation has 10 lines, the original 9'])
  const bad = ['## Title', '', 'plain lines', `| a | ${CELL_VI} | x |`, '```', 'code', '```', `${BEFORE_VI} ${EM_DASH} after`, ''].join('\n')
  assert.deepEqual(translationProblems(ORIGINAL, bad), [
    'line 1 changed its heading level',
    'line 3 changed, though it needed no translation',
    'line 4 keeps a letter outside ASCII',
    'line 4 changed its table cells',
    'line 8 keeps a letter outside ASCII',
    'line 8 keeps an em or en dash'
  ])
})

test('chunks cut at a heading outside code, stay within the size, and join back byte for byte', () => {
  const text = ['# A', 'a1', '## B', 'b1', 'b2', 'b3', 'b4', '```', '# not a heading', '```', 'c'].join('\n')
  const chunks = chunksOf(text, 4)
  assert.equal(chunks.join(''), text)
  // The first chunk ends before the heading near its end; with no heading near, a chunk ends at the size.
  assert.deepEqual(chunks.map((chunk) => chunk.split('\n')[0]), ['# A', '## B', 'b4', 'c'])
  assert.deepEqual(chunksOf('one\ntwo\n', 10), ['one\ntwo\n'])
})
````

````js
// Migration tools for the records of metis-docs, kept outside the repositories: the originals they
// compare stay in the owner's private store.
//   node translation.mjs check <original> <translation>   a translation keeps its original line for line
//   node translation.mjs split <file> <max lines> <folder> chunks a long record at headings
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'

const LETTER = /(?![\x00-\x7F])\p{L}/u
const DASH = /[\u2013\u2014]/
const FENCE = /^\s*(```|~~~)/
const HEADING = /^(#{1,6} )/
const BANNER_END = '<!-- end of record banner -->'

// The body of a page: its text without the header, the record banner and the blank lines before it.
export function bodyOf(text) {
  let lines = text.split('\n')
  if (lines[0] === '---') lines = lines.slice(lines.indexOf('---', 1) + 1)
  while (lines[0] === '') lines = lines.slice(1)
  const banner = lines.indexOf(BANNER_END)
  if (banner >= 0) lines = lines.slice(banner + 1)
  while (lines[0] === '') lines = lines.slice(1)
  return lines
}

const cells = (line) => line.replace(/\\\|/g, '').split('|').length

// Each way a translation breaks its original: another line count, a line that needed no translation
// but changed, a heading or a table row that lost its shape, a letter or a dash left behind.
export function translationProblems(original, translation) {
  const before = bodyOf(original)
  const after = bodyOf(translation)
  if (before.length !== after.length) {
    return [`the translation has ${after.length} lines, the original ${before.length}`]
  }
  return before.flatMap((line, i) => {
    const done = after[i]
    const at = `line ${i + 1}`
    if (!LETTER.test(line.normalize('NFC')) && !DASH.test(line)) {
      return done === line ? [] : [`${at} changed, though it needed no translation`]
    }
    const problems = []
    if (LETTER.test(done.normalize('NFC'))) problems.push(`${at} keeps a letter outside ASCII`)
    if (DASH.test(done)) problems.push(`${at} keeps an em or en dash`)
    if (line.match(HEADING)?.[1] !== done.match(HEADING)?.[1]) {
      problems.push(`${at} changed its heading level`)
    }
    if (line.startsWith('|') && cells(line) !== cells(done)) {
      problems.push(`${at} changed its table cells`)
    }
    return problems
  })
}

// Chunks of at most max lines, cut at a heading outside code where one is near; joined in order they
// give back the file byte for byte.
export function chunksOf(text, max) {
  const lines = text.split('\n')
  const chunks = []
  let start = 0
  let fenced = false
  let cut = -1
  lines.forEach((line, i) => {
    if (FENCE.test(line)) fenced = !fenced
    else if (!fenced && HEADING.test(line) && i > start) cut = i
    if (i - start + 1 >= max && i + 1 < lines.length) {
      const end = cut > start ? cut : i + 1
      chunks.push(lines.slice(start, end))
      start = end
      cut = -1
    }
  })
  chunks.push(lines.slice(start))
  return chunks.map((chunk, i) => chunk.join('\n') + (i < chunks.length - 1 ? '\n' : ''))
}

/* node:coverage disable */
// Command line only; translation.test.mjs runs the functions.
if (process.argv[1] && realpathSync(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const [command, ...args] = process.argv.slice(2)
  if (command === 'check') {
    const [original, translation] = args.map((path) => readFileSync(path, 'utf8'))
    const problems = translationProblems(original, translation)
    for (const line of problems) console.log(`${args[1]}: ${line}`)
    console.log(problems.length ? `translation: ${problems.length} problems` : 'translation: kept line for line')
    process.exitCode = problems.length ? 1 : 0
  } else if (command === 'split') {
    const [file, max, folder] = args
    mkdirSync(folder, { recursive: true })
    const chunks = chunksOf(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'), Number(max))
    chunks.forEach((chunk, i) => {
      const name = join(folder, `part-${String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0')}.md`)
      writeFileSync(name, chunk)
      console.log(`${name}: ${chunk.split('\n').length} lines`)
    })
  } else {
    console.log('usage: node translation.mjs check <original> <translation> | split <file> <max lines> <folder>')
    process.exitCode = 2
  }
}
/* node:coverage enable */
````

```js
// Tests of the page-specific oracles on a small repository, run with node --test. Its tools/docs.mjs is
// the real one, copied from METIS_DOCS (default ~/metis-run/repos/metis-docs).
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import { copyFileSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { homedir, tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import { after, test } from 'node:test'

import {
  DECISION_SECTIONS,
  DRAFTS,
  JOURNEY_SECTIONS,
  JOURNEYS,
  MODULE_SECTIONS,
  PLANNED,
  RULES
} from './page-oracles.mjs'

const DOCS = process.env.METIS_DOCS ?? join(homedir(), 'metis-run/repos/metis-docs')
const IDS = ['OVW-01', 'OVW-02', 'BR-42', 'ONB-13']
const SOURCE = 'business/requirements/source'
const page = (fields, body) => {
  const { title = 'T', component = 'all', type = 'overview', status = 'current', ids = [] } = fields
  return `---\ntitle: ${title}\nsummary: S.\ncomponent: ${component}\ntype: ${type}\nstatus: ${status}\nids: [${ids.join(', ')}]\n---\n\n# ${title}\n\n${body}\n`
}
const sections = (list) => list.map((heading) => `${heading}\n\ntext\n`).join('\n')

const roots = []
after(() => roots.forEach((root) => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true })))
const repository = (files) => {
  const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'oracles-'))
  roots.push(root)
  mkdirSync(join(root, 'tools'))
  copyFileSync(join(DOCS, 'tools/docs.mjs'), join(root, 'tools/docs.mjs'))
  const base = {
    [`${SOURCE}/build.py`]: `print("\\n".join(${JSON.stringify(IDS)}))\n`,
    [`${SOURCE}/parts/02-modules.md`]: [
      '## M10 Project Overview (OVW)',
      '',
      ...JOURNEYS.filter(([, source]) => !source.startsWith('6.1')).map(([, source]) =>
        source === 'Gate review' ? '**Gate review:** decided under BR-42.' : `**${source}:** steps.`
      ),
      ''
    ].join('\n'),
    [`${SOURCE}/parts/05-appendices.md`]: '# Appendix A. Glossary\n\n| Term | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| Baseline | A snapshot |\n\n# Appendix B. X\n',
    [`${SOURCE}/addendum-onboarding/parts/01-front.md`]: '## 6.1 Steps\n\nThe X-ray (ONB-13).\n\n## 6.2 Facts\n',
    [`${SOURCE}/addendum-onboarding/parts/05-appendices.md`]: '# Appendix A. Glossary Additions\n\n| Term | Meaning |\n|---|---|\n| Draft workspace | A workspace |\n'
  }
  for (const [path, text] of Object.entries({ ...base, ...files })) {
    mkdirSync(dirname(join(root, path)), { recursive: true })
    writeFileSync(join(root, path), text)
  }
  return root
}

test('modules: one page per BRD module, type module, every id of its prefix, the four sections', async () => {
  const good = page({ type: 'module', ids: ['OVW-02', 'OVW-01'] }, sections(MODULE_SECTIONS))
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.modules(repository({ 'business/modules/M10-overview.md': good })), [])
  const broken = repository({
    'business/modules/M10-overview.md': page({ type: 'overview', ids: ['OVW-01'] }, sections(MODULE_SECTIONS.slice(1))),
    'business/modules/M99-none.md': good
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.modules(broken), [
    'business/modules/M99-none.md: no BRD module has this number',
    'business/modules/M10-overview.md: type module and status current',
    'business/modules/M10-overview.md: header ids are not the 2 ids of OVW',
    `business/modules/M10-overview.md: sections ${MODULE_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`
  ])
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.modules(repository({})), ['business/modules: 0 pages for M10, not 1'])
  const headless = repository({ 'business/modules/M10-overview.md': '# No header\n' })
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.modules(headless), [
    'business/modules/M10-overview.md: type module and status current',
    'business/modules/M10-overview.md: header ids are not the 2 ids of OVW',
    `business/modules/M10-overview.md: sections ${MODULE_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`
  ])
})

test('journeys: each page exists, carries the ids its BRD paragraph names, and the three sections', async () => {
  const files = Object.fromEntries(
    JOURNEYS.map(([name]) => [`business/journeys/${name}`, page({ type: 'journey', ids: ['BR-42', 'ONB-13', 'WSP-14'] }, sections(JOURNEY_SECTIONS))])
  )
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.journeys(repository(files)), [])
  const [gate] = JOURNEYS.find(([, source]) => source === 'Gate review')
  const [guided] = JOURNEYS.find(([, source]) => source === '6.1 Steps')
  const broken = repository({
    ...files,
    [`business/journeys/${gate}`]: page({ type: 'overview' }, 'no sections'),
    [`business/journeys/${guided}`]: page({ type: 'journey' }, sections(JOURNEY_SECTIONS))
  })
  const [first] = JOURNEYS[0]
  const [, second] = JOURNEYS[1]
  rmSync(join(broken, `business/journeys/${first}`))
  const parts = join(broken, SOURCE, 'parts/02-modules.md')
  writeFileSync(parts, readFileSync(parts, 'utf8').replace(`**${second}:**`, '**Renamed:**'))
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.journeys(broken), [
    `business/journeys/${first}: missing`,
    `business/journeys/${JOURNEYS[1][0]}: the BRD has no paragraph "${second}"`,
    `business/journeys/${gate}: type journey`,
    `business/journeys/${gate}: header ids lack BR-42`,
    `business/journeys/${gate}: sections ${JOURNEY_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`,
    `business/journeys/${guided}: header ids lack ONB-13`
  ])
})

test('drafts: a page about a planned part is a draft whose first line says so', async () => {
  const root = repository({
    'architecture/overview.md': page({ status: 'draft' }, `${PLANNED}the core and its parts.`),
    'architecture/decisions/a.md': page({ type: 'decision' }, 'Any first line.'),
    'components/core/README.md': page({ component: 'core' }, 'The core.'),
    'operations/environments.md': page({ status: 'draft' }, 'Development and staging.'),
    'components/app/README.md': page({ component: 'app' }, 'The app.'),
    'components/infra/README.md': '# Infra\n'
  })
  assert.deepEqual(await RULES.drafts(root), [
    ...DRAFTS.filter((path) => !['architecture/overview.md', 'operations/environments.md'].includes(path)).map((path) => `${path}: missing`),
    'components/core/README.md: status draft, for a part planned, not built',
    `components/core/README.md: its first line starts with "${PLANNED}"`,
    'components/infra/README.md: status draft, for a part planned, not built',
    `components/infra/README.md: its first line starts with "${PLANNED}"`,
    `operations/environments.md: its first line starts with "${PLANNED}"`
  ])
})

test('components: every component folder holds the four entries, each with its component', async () => {
  const files = {}
  for (const name of ['app', 'core', 'mcp-gateway', 'agent', 'keycloak', 'sandbox', 'infra']) {
    for (const entry of ['README.md', 'develop.md', 'interfaces.md', 'troubleshoot.md']) {

})

  const root = repository({

    'architecture/decisions/b.md': page({ type: 'decision', status: 'superseded' }, `${body}\nSuperseded by [a](a.md).`),

```js
// The page-specific oracles of plan one, beside the checks of metis-docs/tools: each rule a page of
// one kind must keep. Kept outside the repositories, as translation.mjs is.
//   node page-oracles.mjs <rule|all> <metis-docs> [<today's folder> <metis-app>]
// Rules: modules, journeys, drafts, components, decisions, glossary, records, pins.
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

import { translationProblems } from './translation.mjs'

const SOURCE = 'business/requirements/source'
export const MODULE_SECTIONS = [
  '## What it is for',
  '## What users can do today',
  '## Where the app differs from the BRD',
  '## Open questions'
]
export const JOURNEY_SECTIONS = ['## Steps', '## What works today', '## Modules and screens']
export const DECISION_SECTIONS = ['## Context', '## Decision', '## Consequences', '## Status']
export const PLANNED = 'Planned, not built: '
// The pages about planned parts that plan one writes outside the component folders.
export const DRAFTS = [
  'architecture/overview.md',
  'architecture/tenancy.md',
  'architecture/security.md',
  'architecture/data.md',
  'architecture/contract.md',
  'operations/environments.md'
]
export const COMPONENTS = ['app', 'core', 'mcp-gateway', 'agent', 'keycloak', 'sandbox', 'infra']
const ENTRIES = ['README.md', 'develop.md', 'interfaces.md', 'troubleshoot.md']
// Each journey page and the bold name of its paragraph in BRD 7.9; the guided onboarding journey is
// section 6.1 of the onboarding addendum.
export const JOURNEYS = [
  ['ceo-weekly-review.md', 'CEO weekly review'],
  ['product-director-portfolio-review.md', 'Product Director portfolio review'],
  ['pm-project-setup.md', 'PM project setup'],
  ['pm-and-team-daily-execution.md', 'PM and team daily execution'],
  ['pm-weekly-update.md', 'PM weekly update'],
  ['change-request.md', 'Change request'],
  ['gate-review.md', 'Gate review'],
  ['approver-daily-round.md', 'Approver daily round'],
  ['tenant-onboarding.md', 'Tenant onboarding'],
  ['connect-an-llm-through-mcp.md', 'Connect an LLM through MCP'],
  ['workspace-setup.md', 'Workspace setup (WSP-14)'],
  ['guided-onboarding.md', '6.1 Steps']
]
// Where a record of history/ came from in today's folder.
const ORIGINS = [
  ['history/plans/', 'plan/'],
  ['history/specs/', 'spec/'],
  ['history/code-review/', 'analysis/metis-code-review/'],
  ['history/reviews/', 'review/'],
  ['history/brd/archive/', 'brd/archive/'],
  ['history/brd/legacy/', 'brd/source/legacy/'],
  ['history/brd/addendum-onboarding/', 'brd/source/addendum-onboarding/']
]
const ID = /\b[A-Z]{1,3}-\d{2}\b/g

const read = (root, path) => readFileSync(join(root, path), 'utf8')
const mdUnder = (root, folder) =>
  existsSync(join(root, folder))
    ? readdirSync(join(root, folder)).filter((name) => name.endsWith('.md')).sort()
    : []
// The level-two headings of a page, in order.
const sectionsOf = (text) => text.split('\n').filter((line) => /^## /.test(line))
const inOrder = (found, wanted) => {
  const kept = found.filter((line) => wanted.includes(line))
  return wanted.every((line, i) => kept[i] === line)
}
// The first line of a page's body that is not blank and not its title.
const firstLineOf = (text, lines) =>
  text
    .split('\n')
    .slice(lines)
    .find((line) => line.trim() && !line.startsWith('# '))

// A journey's paragraph in BRD 7.9, which opens with its bold name, or the addendum section it names.
const paragraphOf = (parts, source) => {
  const line = parts.split('\n').find((text) => text.startsWith(`**${source}:**`))
  if (line) return line
  const start = parts.indexOf(`## ${source}\n`)
  return start < 0 ? null : parts.slice(start, parts.indexOf('\n## ', start + 1))
}

async function tools(docs) {
  return import(pathToFileURL(join(docs, 'tools/docs.mjs')).href)
}

// The BRD's modules (number, prefix) from its parts, and every id build.py lists.
export function brdOf(docs, run = spawnSync) {
  const parts = ['parts', 'addendum-onboarding/parts'].flatMap((folder) =>
    mdUnder(docs, `${SOURCE}/${folder}`).map((name) => read(docs, `${SOURCE}/${folder}/${name}`))
  )
  const modules = [...parts.join('\n').matchAll(/^## (M\d{2}) .+ \(([A-Z]{3})\)\s*$/gm)].map(
    ([, number, prefix]) => ({ number, prefix })
  )
  const listed = run('python3', [`${SOURCE}/build.py`, '--ids'], { cwd: docs, encoding: 'utf8' })
  return { modules, ids: listed.stdout.split('\n').filter(Boolean), parts: parts.join('\n') }
}

export const RULES = {
  async modules(docs) {
    const { headerOf } = await tools(docs)
    const { modules, ids } = brdOf(docs)
    const files = mdUnder(docs, 'business/modules')
    const problems = files
      .filter((name) => !modules.some(({ number }) => name.startsWith(`${number}-`)))
      .map((name) => `business/modules/${name}: no BRD module has this number`)
    for (const { number, prefix } of modules) {
      const mine = files.filter((name) => name.startsWith(`${number}-`))
      if (mine.length !== 1) {
        problems.push(`business/modules: ${mine.length} pages for ${number}, not 1`)
        continue
      }
      const path = `business/modules/${mine[0]}`
      const text = read(docs, path)
      const { header } = headerOf(text)
      const own = ids.filter((id) => id.startsWith(`${prefix}-`)).sort()
      if (header?.type !== 'module' || header.status !== 'current') {
        problems.push(`${path}: type module and status current`)
      }
      if (JSON.stringify([...(header?.ids ?? [])].sort()) !== JSON.stringify(own)) {
        problems.push(`${path}: header ids are not the ${own.length} ids of ${prefix}`)
      }
      if (!inOrder(sectionsOf(text), MODULE_SECTIONS)) problems.push(`${path}: sections ${MODULE_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`)
    }
    return problems
  },

  async journeys(docs) {
    const { headerOf } = await tools(docs)
    const { parts } = brdOf(docs)
    const problems = []
    for (const [name, source] of JOURNEYS) {
      const path = `business/journeys/${name}`
      if (!existsSync(join(docs, path))) {
        problems.push(`${path}: missing`)
        continue
      }
      const paragraph = paragraphOf(parts, source)
      if (paragraph === null) {
        problems.push(`${path}: the BRD has no paragraph "${source}"`)
        continue
      }
      const text = read(docs, path)
      const { header } = headerOf(text)
      const missing = [...new Set(paragraph.match(ID) ?? [])].filter((id) => !header?.ids.includes(id))
      if (header?.type !== 'journey') problems.push(`${path}: type journey`)
      if (missing.length) problems.push(`${path}: header ids lack ${missing.join(', ')}`)
      if (!inOrder(sectionsOf(text), JOURNEY_SECTIONS)) problems.push(`${path}: sections ${JOURNEY_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`)
    }
    return problems
  },

  async drafts(docs) {
    const { headerOf, repositoryOf } = await tools(docs)
    const planned = /^(?:architecture\/(?!decisions\/)|components\/(?:core|mcp-gateway|agent|keycloak|sandbox|infra)\/|operations\/environments\.md$)/
    const { pages } = repositoryOf(docs)
    const missing = DRAFTS.filter((path) => !pages.some((page) => page.path === path))
    return missing.map((path) => `${path}: missing`).concat(pages
      .filter(({ path }) => planned.test(path))
      .flatMap(({ path, text }) => {
        const { header, lines } = headerOf(text)
        const first = firstLineOf(text, lines ?? 0) ?? ''
        const problems = []
        if (header?.status !== 'draft') problems.push(`${path}: status draft, for a part planned, not built`)
        if (!first.startsWith(PLANNED)) problems.push(`${path}: its first line starts with "${PLANNED}"`)
        return problems
      }))
  },

  async components(docs) {
    const { headerOf } = await tools(docs)
    return COMPONENTS.flatMap((name) => {
      const folder = `components/${name}`
      const present = mdUnder(docs, folder)
      const missing = ENTRIES.filter((entry) => !present.includes(entry))
      const wrong = present.filter((entry) => headerOf(read(docs, `${folder}/${entry}`)).header?.component !== name)
      return [
        ...missing.map((entry) => `${folder}/${entry}: missing`),
        ...wrong.map((entry) => `${folder}/${entry}: component ${name}`)
      ]
    })
  },

  async decisions(docs) {
    const { headerOf } = await tools(docs)
    const folder = 'architecture/decisions'
    return mdUnder(docs, folder).flatMap((name) => {
      const path = `${folder}/${name}`
      const text = read(docs, path)
      const { header } = headerOf(text)
      const problems = []
      if (header?.type !== 'decision') problems.push(`${path}: type decision`)
      if (!inOrder(sectionsOf(text), DECISION_SECTIONS)) problems.push(`${path}: sections ${DECISION_SECTIONS.join(', ')}`)
      if (header?.status === 'superseded' && !/^Superseded by \[/m.test(text)) {
        problems.push(`${path}: a superseded decision links its successor in a line "Superseded by [...]"`)
      }
      return problems
    })
  },

  async glossary(docs) {
    const glossary = existsSync(join(docs, 'business/glossary.md')) ? read(docs, 'business/glossary.md') : ''
    const appendices = ['parts/05-appendices.md', 'addendum-onboarding/parts/05-appendices.md']
    const terms = appendices.flatMap((part) => {
      const text = read(docs, `${SOURCE}/${part}`)
      const table = text.slice(text.indexOf('# Appendix A'), text.indexOf('\n# ', text.indexOf('# Appendix A') + 1))
      return [...table.matchAll(/^\| ([^|]+?) \|/gm)].map(([, term]) => term).filter((term) => !/^(Term|-+)$/.test(term))
    })
    return terms.filter((term) => !glossary.includes(term)).map((term) => `business/glossary.md: no entry for "${term}"`)
  },

  async records(docs, today) {
    const table = JSON.parse(read(docs, 'history/records.json'))
    return Object.entries(table)
      .filter(([, record]) => record.translation !== 'none')
      .flatMap(([path]) => {
        const [from, to] = ORIGINS.find(([prefix]) => path.startsWith(prefix))
        const original = read(today, to + path.slice(from.length))
        return translationProblems(original, read(docs, path)).map((problem) => `${path}: ${problem}`)
      })
  },

  async pins(docs, today, app) {
    const { files } = JSON.parse(read(app, 'docs.lock'))
    return Object.keys(files)
      .filter((path) => !readFileSync(join(app, 'pinned', path)).equals(readFileSync(join(docs, path))))
      .map((path) => `pinned/${path}: differs from ${path} in metis-docs`)
  }
}

/* node:coverage disable */
// Command line only; page-oracles.test.mjs runs the rules.
if (process.argv[1] && realpathSync(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
  const [rule, docs, today, app] = process.argv.slice(2)
  const names = rule === 'all' ? Object.keys(RULES) : [rule]
  let count = 0
  for (const name of names) {
    const problems = await RULES[name](docs, today, app)
    for (const line of problems) console.log(line)
    console.log(problems.length ? `oracle ${name}: ${problems.length} problems` : `oracle ${name}: clean`)
    count += problems.length
  }
  process.exitCode = count ? 1 : 0
}
/* node:coverage enable */
```

```js
// Writes .github/CODEOWNERS of metis-docs from the owner's GitHub handles or team slugs, as spec 3.7
// assigns the folders. Usage: node codeowners.mjs <owners.json> <metis-docs working tree>
// owners.json: { "productOwner", "ba", "designer", "frontendLead", "backendLead", "infraLead" } and, to
// name another lead for a component, "components": { "<component>": "<handle>" }.
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'

const [file, docs] = process.argv.slice(2)
const owners = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))
const lead = {
  app: owners.frontendLead,
  core: owners.backendLead,
  'mcp-gateway': owners.backendLead,
  agent: owners.backendLead,
  keycloak: owners.backendLead,
  sandbox: owners.backendLead,
  infra: owners.infraLead,
  ...owners.components
}
const rows = [
  ['/business/', owners.productOwner, owners.ba],
  ['/design/', owners.designer, owners.frontendLead],
  ['/architecture/', owners.backendLead, owners.frontendLead],
  ...Object.entries(lead).map(([name, handle]) => [`/components/${name}/`, handle]),
  ['/operations/', owners.infraLead]
]
const bad = rows.flatMap(([, ...handles]) => handles).filter((handle) => !/^@[\w.-]+(?:\/[\w.-]+)?$/.test(handle ?? ''))
if (bad.length) {
  console.log(`codeowners: not a GitHub handle or team: ${bad.map(String).join(', ')}`)
  process.exit(1)
}
const text = [
  '# Who approves a change to each folder (spec 3.7). GitHub requires these reviews on private',
  '# repositories only on its Team plan; on GitHub Free this file waits for that upgrade.',
  ...rows.map(([path, ...handles]) => `${path} ${[...new Set(handles)].join(' ')}`),
  ''
].join('\n')
mkdirSync(join(docs, '.github'), { recursive: true })
writeFileSync(join(docs, '.github/CODEOWNERS'), text)
console.log(`codeowners: wrote ${rows.length} rules`)
```

# Metis documentation

The single source of truth about Metis for the team that builds it: the product owner, the BA, the
designer, developers, QA, and the AI agents they work with. It holds no product code: the code lives
in `metis-app`, `metis-backend` and `metis-infra`.

## Where to start

| You want to | Start at |
|---|---|
| understand what Metis does today and for whom | [business/overview.md](business/overview.md) |
| build a feature in a component | that component's folder under [components/](components/), its `README.md` first, then `develop.md` |
| troubleshoot | the component's `troubleshoot.md`, then [operations/](operations/) |
| learn why something is the way it is | [architecture/decisions/](architecture/decisions/) |
| see every current page in one list | [llms.txt](llms.txt) |

## Folders

| Folder | Answers |
|---|---|
| [business/](business/) | What Metis does, for whom: the BRD and its addenda, one page per module and per key journey |
| [design/](design/) | The brand files and the wireframes, the source the code copies |
| [architecture/](architecture/) | How the parts fit, and every decision with its reasons |
| [components/](components/) | One folder per deployable part, each with the same five entries |
| [operations/](operations/) | Environments, runbooks and incident reviews |
| [proposals/](proposals/) | Specs and plans being worked on |
| [history/](history/) | Records: delivered plans, decision logs, reviews, old BRD versions; never current truth |
| [tools/](tools/) | The checks every pull request runs, and the generators of `llms.txt` and the record banners |

## Rules for every change

- English only. Every page opens with the header its folder's pages carry; [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
  describes it.
- A current page tells how things are, not how they changed: git and the decision records keep that.
- `node tools/generate.mjs` rewrites `llms.txt` and the record banners; `node tools/check.mjs` runs
  every check a pull request runs, except the secret scan (`gitleaks dir . --no-banner --redact`).
```

````markdown
---
title: Instructions for AI agents
summary: How AI agents read and write metis-docs, the reading order, the trust order and the writing rules.
component: all
type: how-to
status: current
ids: []
---

# Instructions for AI agents

`metis-docs` is the documentation of Metis, in English, for the team and its AI agents. It holds no
product code. A coding agent in `metis-app`, `metis-backend` or `metis-infra` reads a clone of it
beside the code, at `../metis-docs`.

## Folder map

- `business/`: what Metis does today. `overview.md`, `glossary.md`; `requirements/` (the BRD and its
  addenda, generated from `requirements/source/`); `modules/` (one page per BRD module, M01 to M23);
  `journeys/` (one page per key user journey).
- `design/`: `brand/` (tokens, logos, style guide) and `wireframes/` (the screens, `manifest.json`).
- `architecture/`: `overview.md`, `tenancy.md`, `security.md`, `data.md`, `contract.md`, and
  `decisions/`, one decision per file.
- `components/<app|core|mcp-gateway|agent|keycloak|sandbox|infra>/`: `README.md`, `develop.md`,
  `interfaces.md`, `troubleshoot.md`, and `reference/`, generated from the code.
- `operations/`: `environments.md`, `runbooks/`, `incidents/`.
- `proposals/`: specs and plans being worked on. `history/`: records.
- `tools/`: the checks and generators.

## Reading order

1. `llms.txt`: one line per current page, with its summary.
2. The `README.md` of the component you work on.
3. The pages it points to, then any page whose header `ids` holds the BRD id you work on.

## Trust order

1. A generated page (its header has `generated_from`) is exact: it comes from the code.
2. A current page (`status: current`) describes `main` of the code repositories as it is.
3. A draft page (`status: draft`) describes a part that is planned, not built.
4. A page under `history/` or with `status: superseded` is never current truth. Open it only to
   learn why, and say so when you cite it.

## Writing rules

- English only; no em dash and no en dash.
- Every page opens with this header, its fields in this order:

  ```yaml
  ---
  title: Change request
  summary: How a change request goes from logged to applied, and who decides.
  component: all
  type: journey
  status: current
  ids: [CHG-01, BR-42]
  ---
  ```

  `component` is one of app, core, mcp-gateway, agent, keycloak, sandbox, infra or all; `type` one of
  overview, module, journey, how-to, reference, runbook, decision, incident, proposal or record;
  `status` one of current, draft, superseded or record. `ids` lists the BRD ids the page covers. A
  generated page adds `generated_from`. A title or summary that holds a colon goes in double quotes.
  No date and no owner: git and `.github/CODEOWNERS` hold them.
- One topic per file. Never edit a generated page or a record's banner: change the source and run
  `node tools/generate.mjs`, or the page's generator.
- No history inside a current page. A replaced decision keeps its file, with `status: superseded` and
  a line starting "Superseded by" that links the decision that replaced it.
- A link to a file outside this repository is plain text that names the file.
- Before you hand work back: `node tools/generate.mjs`, then `node tools/check.mjs` must print
  `check: clean`.
````

---
title: Checks and generators
summary: The checks every pull request of metis-docs runs, the generators of llms.txt and the record banners, and how to run them.
component: all
type: how-to
status: current
ids: []

# Checks and generators

Node 24 (`.nvmrc`) and Python 3 run everything here; nothing needs installing.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `node tools/check.mjs` | Every check below; one line per problem as `path:line: rule: message`; exit 1 when there is any |
| `node tools/generate.mjs` | Writes `llms.txt` from the page headers and each record's banner from `history/records.json` |
| `python3 business/requirements/source/build.py --md-only` | Writes the BRD's Markdown edition; `addendum-onboarding` as first argument writes the addendum; without `--md-only` it also builds the Word file, which needs pandoc |
| `node design/wireframes/tools/build-index.mjs` | Writes the wireframe `manifest.json`, `index.html` and `wireframes-digest.md` from the screens |
| `gitleaks dir . --no-banner --redact` | The secret scan, which the pull-request workflow runs with a pinned gitleaks release |

## The checks

| Rule | What fails |
|---|---|
| `header` | A page without the header, a field missing, out of order or with a value outside its list; a record outside `history/`, or a page in `history/` that is not a record; a `generated_from` that names nothing |
| `id` | A header id that the BRD does not define; in a current page that is not generated, an id or a screen number in the text that the BRD or the wireframe manifest does not have |
| `link` | A link whose file does not exist, that leaves the repository, or whose `#anchor` names no heading |
| `non-ascii-letter` | A letter outside ASCII, except on the line after one holding `lang-exception:` and a reason |
| `dash` | An em dash or an en dash, in any text file |
| `generated` | `llms.txt`, a record banner, the BRD's Markdown editions or the wireframe outputs differ from what their generators write now |
| `record` | A page in `history/` without an entry in `history/records.json`, an entry without its page, or an entry replaced by no current page |

A page is a Markdown file, except the root `CLAUDE.md` and the BRD parts under
`business/requirements/source/`, which are fragments of the generated BRD. Command names from the
core's generated catalog join the `id` rule when the core exists.

## Tests

`node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=100 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --test-coverage-exclude='**/*.test.*' 'tools/*.test.mjs'`
```

The brief of each translator:

```text
You translate a record of the Metis project from Vietnamese into English, line for line. It is a
record: never summarize, correct or improve it. Original (read-only): <path in /Users/mrpo/projects/metis
or a chunk file>. Write the translation to <output path>.

1. Keep the number of lines. Line N of your output translates line N of the original; never merge,
   split, add or drop a line, a blank one included.
2. A line with no Vietnamese letter and no em or en dash stays byte for byte.
3. A line with Vietnamese becomes plain English in place. Keep its Markdown: the heading level, the list
   marker and indentation, the number of table cells, inline code, file paths, ids (FE-21, R-B15,
   BR-24), numbers and dates as written, names of products. Inside code, translate Vietnamese comments
   and strings too, and keep every identifier and every piece of syntax.
4. No em dash and no en dash: a comma, a colon or the word "to" instead. No letter outside ASCII: a
   Vietnamese name keeps its letters without their marks.
5. Run node ~/metis-run/repos-tools/translation.mjs check <original> <output> and fix your output until
   it prints "translation: kept line for line".
6. For the first part of a record, also propose its header title and summary (see the plan's Task 14).
```

The controller joins chunks in order (`cat part-01.md ... > body.md`), prepends the header, and writes the page over the moved original.

As built (rulings C52 to C61): 35 translator agents ran in two waves while Task 13 was reviewed (13 and 3 chunk translators, then 14 single records, two groups of small records, two passages translators) and one agent proposed the headers of the 16 English records; each output passed the check before assembly. The controller translated the 69 lines of Vietnamese typed without marks that the check's rule 2 kept byte for byte, listed them in `translations/unmarked.json` (C55), compared numbers, ids and code spans line by line (C53), aligned terms across records (C56, the shape gate, the prompt boilerplate), and assembled the 51 pages with `assemble.mjs` (headers from Step 2 and C26). `records.json` is the Step 1 table without the superseded `web-only-react-dom-stack.md` target, and `history/code-review/brief.md` is `passages` (C60). The banners of translated records end with a sentence on the original's number and date format (C54). Vietnamese text that the app shows stays Vietnamese without marks where a record pairs it with its English copy or a test compares it (C57, C61).

for r in metis-docs metis-app metis-backend metis-infra; do

  { git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD >/dev/null || { git add -A && git commit -m "Initial content of $r"; }; } &&

13. **`gate:deps` depends on the day.** A new advisory published during Task 5 turns it red with no change of the move. Recommendation: the owner decides between waiting for a fix and accepting the advisory with its reason, as `pnpm-workspace.yaml` records the four accepted ones.
